title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يشارك في أعمال المؤتمر العام الأول للهيئة العالمية للعلماء المسلمين
title_en: His Eminence the Sheikh Takes Part in the First General Conference of the International Authority of Muslim Scholars
body_ar:
يشارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بأعمال المؤتمر العام الأول

للهيئة العالمية للعلماء المسلمين التابعة لرابطة العالم الاسلامي المنعقد صباح اليوم الأربعاء

05 /03/ 2014مـ الموافق 04 / 05 / 1435هـ بمكة المكرمة

وقد افتتح المؤتمر بكلمة / سماحة الشيخ عبد العزيز بن عبد الله بن آل الشيخ المفتي العام للمملكة العربية السعودية ورئيس المجلس الأعلى للرابطة ، وكلمة معالي الدكتور عبد الله بن عبد المحسن التركي الأمين العام لرابطة العالم الإسلامي ، وكلمة فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ،رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا . وكلمة فضيلة الدكتور سعد بن علي الشهراني، الأمين العام للهيئة العالمية للعلماء المسلمين . 

وقد ألقى فضيلة الشيخ العلامة محمد الحسن ولد الددو كلمة الضيوف تناول فيها مكانة العلماء والرسالة التي حملوا حيث أحال الباري إليهم بوصفهم أولي الأمر الذين يرجع إليهم في الاستنباط .

و في ختام المؤتمر تم انتخاب فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ضمن مجلس أمناء الهيئة الذي يضم 15 عالما من كبار علماء الأمة الاسلامية.

ومن المفترض أن يناقش الملتقى تقرير الأمانة العامة للهيئة الذي يتضمن منجزاتها وبرامجها المستقبلية وخططها في تحقيق الأهداف التي أنشئت من أجلها، وفي مقدمتها

تحقيق وحدة علماء الأمة والتنسيق بينهم وتحقيق التعاون بين مؤسسات الدعوة التي يشرفون عليها .

وسيستعرض خلال المؤتمر معالم الخطة الاستراتيجية للهيئة، ويدرس مقترح وزارة الأوقاف والشؤون الإسلامية في دولة الكويت حول مشروع أكاديمية أم القرى لنشر تراث

الآل والأصحاب، ومشروع منظمة خير القرون .

و يرأس المؤتمر فضيلة الشيخ عبدالعزيز بن عبدالله آل الشيخ، المفتي العام للمملكة العربية السعودية، رئيس المجلس الأعلى للرابطة
body_en:
His eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, is taking part in the work of the First General Conference

of the International Authority of Muslim Scholars, affiliated to the Muslim World League, convened this Wednesday morning,

05/03/2014, corresponding to 04/05/1435 AH, in Mecca the Ennobled.

The conference was opened with an address by his eminence Sheikh Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah ibn Al al-Sheikh, Grand Mufti of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and president of the Supreme Council of the League; an address by his excellency Dr Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muhsin al-Turki, Secretary-General of the Muslim World League; an address by his eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania; and an address by his eminence Dr Saʿd ibn Ali al-Shahrani, Secretary-General of the International Authority of Muslim Scholars.

His eminence the learned Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew delivered the guests' address, in which he took up the standing of the scholars and the mission they have borne, in that the Creator referred [people] to them as those in authority to whom recourse is had in the derivation of rulings (al-istinbāṭ).

At the close of the conference, his eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew was elected to the Authority's Board of Trustees, which comprises 15 scholars from among the senior scholars of the Islamic Ummah.

The gathering is expected to discuss the report of the Authority's General Secretariat, which sets out its achievements, its future programmes and its plans for realising the aims for which it was founded, foremost among them

the realising of the unity of the scholars of the Ummah and of co-ordination among them, and the realising of co-operation among the daʿwah institutions they supervise.

During the conference the landmarks of the Authority's strategic plan will be reviewed, and it will consider the proposal of the Ministry of Endowments and Islamic Affairs of the State of Kuwait concerning the project of the Umm al-Qura Academy for the dissemination of the heritage

of the Family and the Companions, and the project of the Best of Generations Organisation.

The conference is chaired by his eminence Sheikh Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah Al al-Sheikh, Grand Mufti of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, president of the Supreme Council of the League

flags.arabic: صيغة الخبر الصحفي (قال فضيلة الشيخ... مؤكدا... وأضاف...)
options: render as a site news report, with the Sheikh's words marked as the site's paraphrase
render as a text by the Sheikh
flags.note: NOT A TEXT BY THE SHEIKH. This record is the site's own news write-up. Outside the passages placed in quotation marks, every formulation is the site editor's indirect report of what the Sheikh said, not his own wording, and the English preserves the reporting verbs (the Sheikh said that..., he affirmed that...) so that a reader can see this. It must not be displayed as a fatwa or as a text of his. The underlying address or lecture is not in this record.

flags.arabic: حيث أحال الباري إليهم بوصفهم أولي الأمر الذين يرجع إليهم في الاستنباط
flags.context: the one sentence summarising Sheikh al-Dedew's own address to the conference
options: as those in authority to whom recourse is had in the derivation of rulings (al-istinbāṭ)
as those charged with the affair, to whom questions are referred for legal derivation
as the people of authority who are competent to extract rulings from the texts
flags.note: Two live terms. (1) أولو الأمر is the Qur'anic phrase (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:59, and 4:83 which is the verse about istinbāṭ being alluded to here); classical exegesis divides over whether it means the rulers or the scholars, and the Sheikh is reported as taking it of the SCHOLARS. That reading must survive in English and must not be flattened to 'rulers'. (2) الاستنباط is the technical uṣūl term for extracting a ruling from the texts; it is not in the glossary and is a candidate for addition. The source gives no Qur'anic citation and none has been added.

options: reproduce both dates numerically as printed
expand the Hijri date to 4 Jumada al-Ula 1435
flags.note: The two dates agree (5 March 2014 falls in early Jumada al-Ula 1435), so this is not a defect. The Hijri month is given only as a numeral in the source, so the English leaves it as a numeral rather than naming a month the source did not name.

flags.arabic: أكاديمية أم القرى لنشر تراث الآل والأصحاب، ومشروع منظمة خير القرون
flags.context: the proposals the conference was to consider
options: the Umm al-Qura Academy for the dissemination of the heritage of the Family and the Companions; the Best of Generations Organisation
the Umm al-Qura Academy for publishing the legacy of the Prophet's Household and his Companions; the Khayr al-Qurun Organisation
flags.note: الآل والأصحاب means the Prophet's Household and his Companions; the pairing is a deliberate formula. خير القرون ('the best of generations') alludes to the prophetic report naming the first three generations. Both are proper names of projects; the English gives a translated name so the reader can see what they are, but the Arabic should be retained if these bodies have official English names.

flags.arabic: عبد العزيز بن عبد الله بن آل الشيخ
flags.context: the Grand Mufti's name in the fourth paragraph
options: read as عبد العزيز بن عبد الله آل الشيخ
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11), minor: the first occurrence inserts an extra بن before آل الشيخ, which the last paragraph of the same record does not. Reproduced as printed in both places and flagged rather than harmonised.

flags.context: the CMS timestamp on the record
options: treat as the date the item was uploaded to the CMS
treat as the date of composition
flags.note: CORPUS-WIDE DEFECT. The CMS serves a bulk-upload timestamp, not the date the Sheikh spoke or wrote. date_is_cms_upload is set true. Where the body itself names a date, that internal date is the better evidence and is kept in the English.

translator_notes: The paragraph breaks in the source fall in mid-sentence in several places (after 'First General Conference', after 'foremost among them', after 'the heritage'). This is the site's own line-breaking of a pasted text, and body_ar preserves it exactly; body_en reproduces the same breaks so the bilingual panes stay aligned.

الهيئة العالمية للعلماء المسلمين (Muslim World League) is a different body from الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين (the International Union of Muslim Scholars) of record 850. Two distinct organisations with near-identical English names; the distinction has been kept and should not be collapsed by an editor.
وزارة الأوقاف is rendered 'Ministry of Endowments' (glossary: waqf, endowment).
The record's final sentence has no full stop in the source; none has been added.
